## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Périgueux, France. It starts at Lieu – dit Maillol.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore a wildlife park that takes you back in time. The various scenographic areas offer a unique interactive experience, allowing you to meet the animal species that lived alongside Cro-Magnon – the mammoth, cave bear, spotted hyena and megaceros.
>
> Learn about the techniques of prehistoric artists in a museum space dedicated to their daily lives. To complete your visit, the park offers the possibility of observing the living descendants of the animals encountered, hunted and depicted by the Lascaux artists – the aurochs, deer, ibex, bison, horses and wolves.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.08. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 52 ratings and 21 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
